verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting lets SREs create alert rules across multiple data sources, consolidate alerts in one view, and route notifications to Slack/PagerDuty/OpsGenie/VictorOps (grafana-docs-25, grafana-docs-30, grafana-gh-7), and community confirms it works well across varied backends (grafana-comm-6). Notification routing is backed by an Alertmanager-compatible engine, and community feedback notes the added complexity of configuring Alertmanager-style routing (grafana-comm-10), but no evidence contradicts that grouping/silencing work as designed. missing for 10: explicit documentation citations naming 'grouping' and 'silencing' features directly, and independent hands-on validation of those specific mechanics.
